name: honkio
description: Send SMS and email, verify phones, buy Canadian numbers and check CASL consent from Gemini CLI, through HonkIO.

settings.name: HonkIO API key
settings.description: Create one at https://honkio.ca/dashboard/keys (API Keys → Create key); the full key is shown once. Start with a test key (mk_test_...): it works before your first top-up, and sends and verifications are simulated for free. Buying or releasing numbers, changing webhooks and running erasure need a live key.
